# ALVStore

> Bespoke private cinema design, native 4K laser projection, architectural acoustics, and reference home theater engineering across India (established 2009, Udaipur studio).

## Main Pages

- [ALVStore Studio Gallery](https://alvstore.com/): Private cinema systems, interactive spatial room planner (5.1, 5.1.2, 7.2.2, 7.2.4), engineering workflow, and after-sales care.
- [Contact & Consultation](https://alvstore.com/contact): Phone (+91 98876 01200), email (sales@alvstore.in), Udaipur studio directions, and in-home site survey booking.

## Capabilities & Authorised Brands

- **Projection & Screens**: Sony SXRD and JVC D-ILA native 4K laser projectors paired with woven acoustically transparent screens (120"–220").
- **Amplification & Processors**: Denon AVC series, Marantz Cinema separates, and Arcam Class G amplification with Dirac Live & Audyssey MultEQ XT32 room calibration.
- **Architectural Audio**: JBL Synthesis, Bowers & Wilkins, KEF Uni-Q, and Polk Audio calibrated multi-channel and multi-subwoofer speaker arrays.
- **After-Sales & Support**: Scheduled Dirac Live re-tuning, projector laser optical servicing, HDMI 2.1 eARC diagnostics, and pan-India warranty care.

## Studio Details

- **Location**: Shop No. 2, 229, Alok School Road, Sector 11, Hiran Magri, Udaipur, Rajasthan 313001, India
- **Hours**: Mon – Sat, 10:00 – 20:00 IST · Sunday by appointment
